data.body: Change 3533 patch set 1 merged as 2a7342013fa at 04:52 PST 2026-11-23 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved, revision-scoped submit). make verify before push: 21892 passed / 34 skipped default tier, 231 passed / 2 skipped integration tier. LLM-Review advisories, verified and being fixed in a follow-up change (commit 35c1983cb07, worktree fu-7c81-gen-check) instead of a new patch set, which would have reset the green votes on the fix the rotation waits on: (1) service-user.sh accepted --generate-http-password output lacking the 'New password: ' prefix if the rest was token-shaped, so a stray single-word line could be stored as the token; the prefix is now required. (2) On that failure the script now says Gerrit's token was already replaced and SSM was not updated. (3) A CR-terminated line is tested; the earlier stub could not deliver a CR. Ticket stays in_progress until the follow-up merges. Box check for antiviral-agrarian-amurminnow during this change's review: PASS (recorded there).
